title: plastic, but HUGE
text: plastic, but HUGE. The 'cut crystal' desgin is actually very pretty.  It arrived whole and unbroken.  I like that it will hold a lot of punch (up to 12 quarts), we have a big family and so we need a big punch bowl!  The benefits of plastic are definitely less weight and easier cleaning (don't have worry about glass shattering).  It's big enough you could make a HUGE salad in it too.  While I was really hoping for glass, I am actually glad I went plastic.
